pricing.faqChangeTier: Can I change my tier at any time?
pricing.faqChangeTierAnswer: Yes â€” upgrades take effect immediately and you're billed the pro-rated difference. Downgrades take effect at the end of your current billing period. No penalties or fees for changing tiers.
pricing.faqPaymentTerms: How do Net-{days} payment terms work?
pricing.faqPaymentTermsAnswer: Once approved (takes 48 hours), you can place orders and pay within your allotted window. Approval is based on your account history and a soft business credit check â€” no hard pull on personal credit.
pricing.faqTradePoints: What are trade points and how do I redeem them?
pricing.faqTradePointsAnswer: Trade points are earned monthly and on every order. {points} points = ${value} off your next order. They can also be redeemed for freight credits, supplier introductions, or early deal access passes.
pricing.faqMinimum: Is there a minimum order value to use VIP discounts?
pricing.faqMinimumAnswer: No minimum order value. Your VIP discount applies to every order regardless of size. However, some supplier-specific promotions may have their own MOQ conditions.
pricing.faqAnnual: How does the annual billing discount work?
pricing.faqAnnualAnswer: Paying annually gives you 2 months free (20% savings). You're charged the full year upfront. If you cancel, unused months are refunded pro-rata within 5 business days.

deleteAccount.warningText: Once your request is processed, your account and all associated data will be permanently deleted, including your listings, messages, and profile.
deleteAccount.reasonPlaceholder: Tell us why you want to delete your account...
deleteAccount.successText: Your request will be reviewed and processed within 7 business days. You will receive an email confirmation when the process is complete.
deleteAccount.loginRequired: You must be logged in to submit an account deletion request.
deleteAccount.alreadyRequested: You already have a pending deletion request.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy describes how Souq Al-Memar ('we' or 'the App') collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our application and website.
collectItems: Account information: name, email address, and password when you register.
Profile data: profile photo, professional specialty, and contact information you provide.
Location data: when permission is granted, to show nearby suppliers and projects.
Camera and photos: when uploading project images or a profile photo.
Usage data: pages you visit and features you use to improve your experience.
Push notifications: device token to send notifications about your requests and messages.
useItems: To operate, improve, and personalise the service for you.
To communicate with you about your requests, updates, and offers.
To show relevant suppliers, tenders, and projects near your location.
To ensure platform security and prevent fraud.
privacy.shareText: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share information with service providers necessary to operate the app (such as hosting services) under strict data-protection agreements.
privacy.storageText: Your data is stored on our secure servers. We use HTTPS encryption for all communications and apply industry-standard security measures to protect your information.
rightsItems: Access and correct your personal data.
Request deletion of your account and data.
Opt out of marketing notifications at any time.
Disable location permission from your device settings.
privacy.childrenText: Our app is intended for users aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect information from children under 13.
privacy.contactText: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
